title: Dispatch: fix four magic-item mechanics modeling defects (attempt 1)
description:
PR #455 review finding batch A. Fix in the SRD importer (docs/importer-fix-protocol.md applies; regenerate pack; never weaken tests):
1. staff-of-frost (magicItem spell-cast family): castSpell effects for cone-of-cold/ice-storm/wall-of-ice carry fixed saveDc:17 but source says 'using your spell save DC' — change to 'owner-spell-save-dc' exactly like staff-of-fire.
2. rod-of-lordly-might (magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts): pressing the SAME button must revert to mace ('until you push the same button again, which causes the rod to revert to its normal form'). Current transitions self-loop (e.g. flame-tongue via press-button-1 -> flame-tongue). Fix all five same-button transitions to target 'mace' (mace via press-button-6 -> mace stays correct).
3. cube-of-force (magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts): table:cube-of-force-faces row 6 = 'The barrier deactivates' (0 charges). Remove the 'face-6' barrier state; press-face-6 from any active face must transition to 'inactive'; 'inactive' must not offer press-face-6 as an activation into a barrier state (model as no-op or omit). Keep the doesNotExpend/no-cost semantics of face 6.
4. staff-of-thunder-and-lightning (magicItemChargeEconomies.ts): the combined 'thunder-and-lightning' operation lacks activation {cost:'action'} ('You can use an action to use the Lightning Strike and Thunderclap properties at the same time') and lacks effect bindings to c2-lightning-strike-payload and c2-thunderclap-payload. Add both.
Update any membership/frequency/clause-expectation allowlists explicitly; npm run import:dnd5e-srd + verify:dnd5e-srd-pack + full npm run verify:worktree must pass.
notes:

- Regenerated canonical pack via importer; generated diff was limited to those four intended mechanic changes. Updated semi-structured boundary inventory populations from its generator for the reviewed artifact.
